objective: Implement the approved QuantPilot CLI/Slack paper intraday redesign; bounded independent strategy and AI/lab modules, preserving existing user edits and all trading safety boundaries.

receipt.summary: Implemented the standalone offline intraday strategy and allocation module with focused tests. Fresh verification passes all 12 tests; no commit was created.

commands.outcome: No forbidden integration or network imports found; rg returns 1 for no matches.
Both new-file diffs were inspected; no whitespace errors were reported. Exit 1 denotes a detected new-file diff.
Imports are limited to __future__, dataclasses, datetime, math, and typing.

criteria.criterion: Three deterministic intraday strategies with frozen thresholds and timestamp safety
criteria.evidence: Implemented opening_range_breakout, trend_pullback, and range_reversion using completed bars only. Tests cover real triggers, warmup, gaps, duplicates, mixed symbols, incomplete bars, aligned 5-minute aggregation, and risk geometry.

criteria.criterion: Allocation caps and duplicate symbol selection tested
criteria.evidence: Tests verify the 60% concentration cap, retained cash, no allocation without market evidence, bounded AI influence, unknown AI-key rejection, and deterministic highest-score selection per unoccupied symbol.

criteria.criterion: No broker imports, no network, no edits outside ownership
criteria.evidence: AST and text audits found only standard-library imports. Exactly the two authorized files were changed.

receipt.summary: 구독 CLI 기반 평가·리뷰 어댑터와 해시 결속 전략 랩, fail-closed Docker 신호 샌드박스를 구현했습니다. 런타임/CLI 통합이나 커밋 없이 허용된 네 파일만 변경했으며 최종 지정 테스트 21개가 통과했습니다.

commands.outcome: 로컬 CLI의 구조화 출력, 제한 모드, 도구/MCP 비활성화 인자를 확인했습니다.
두 구현 모듈의 구문 검증을 통과했습니다.
개발 중 일일 생성 제한의 날짜 비교 오류 1건을 발견했습니다.

commands.command: python -m pytest quantpilot/tests/unit/test_paper_intelligence.py quantpilot/tests/unit/test_paper_strategy_lab.py -q; scoped diff checks; git status
commands.outcome: 수정 후 최종 21개 테스트 통과, 공백 오류 없음, 변경 범위가 지정된 네 파일과 정확히 일치합니다.

criteria.criterion: Provider failover and TTL validated without network in tests
criteria.evidence: 가짜 runner로 primary→alternate 단일 failover, malformed/timeout 처리, host-stamped 75분 TTL, future/stale usable 경계와 Claude/Codex CLI 가드를 검증했습니다.

criteria.criterion: Generated code cannot access trading authority and promotion requires hash-bound independent evidence
criteria.evidence: AI 출력은 inert source/prose data로만 반환됩니다. 승격은 코드 해시·버전, 생성 이후의 신뢰된 KRX forward evidence, 20개 고유 CLOSED 거래, 5개 세션, 양수 비용조정 순손익, 세 종류 검증 및 독립 provider 리뷰에 결속됩니다.

criteria.criterion: Sandbox absent/failing blocks code execution; tests exercise failure cases
criteria.evidence: disabled/not-ready/timeout/output-limit/malformed order-like output을 모두 차단했습니다. Docker argv의 digest pin, no-pull, no-network, read-only, capability drop, no-new-privileges, CPU/memory/PID/time/output 제한과 두 개의 임시 read-only mount만 허용됨을 검증했습니다.
